subject: Low-priority follow-up: introduce real i18n
body:
Assignment 2 (low priority, separate from the English restoration): introduce real i18n.

Requirements:
- Survey existing Vue 3 + Element Plus i18n options first; use a >1k-star established package and record the star evidence in design/09.
- Do not hand-roll a translation system.
- Centralize all user-visible strings; component templates should not contain parallel bilingual conditionals.
- Persist language preference and support route/query-independent locale switching.
- Ensure language does not change data model vocabulary (status, phase, priority, tags remain canonical English identifiers).
- Element Plus locale and date/number formatting must match selected language.
- Add tests for language switching and persistence.

Do not mix this task with the immediate all-English consistency patch.
